lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is positioned posterior to the branchial region, arranged in approximately six vertical columns between the pectoral and dorsal fins.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary white blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with a highlight on the superior edge and a shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a higher spatial density of smaller, lower-intensity spots relative to the primary constellation on the lateral flank.
